title: MSA §5.3 vendor-disclosure records — re-filing of W012297
summary:
A re-filing of W012297-030826 covering MSA §5.3 vendor-disclosure records:

- notifications from Flock to SMPD about §5.3 disclosures,
- SMPD records monitoring or tracking such disclosures,
- SMPD/Flock communications about §5.3 scope (including any review under AG Bulletin 2023-DLE-06), and
- any analysis or memorandum considering §5.3 alongside Civil Code §1798.90.55(b).

Includes scope clarifications intended to reduce review volume by identifying non-responsive record types.

policy_promises.quote: Flock may disclose Customer Data as required to provide the Services
policy_promises.tests: What records reflect Flock's exercise of §5.3, and SMPD's awareness of any such disclosure?

policy_promises.quote: ALPR information shall not be sold, shared, or transferred except to another public agency
directing law enforcement agencies to review vendor agreements for provisions allowing access beyond California public agencies
policy_promises.tests: What records reflect the AG-directed review?

prior_pra_refs.note: The original request was filed 2026-03-08 and closed on 2026-05-06 by consolidation into W012462-040226's email corpus. This re-filing covers the substantive questions on a clean docket.
W012462 was withdrawn 2026-05-06; the original consolidation into that request is no longer in effect.

filed_because: Re-files the substantive §5.3 questions after the original consolidation target was withdrawn. Asks the Department to treat the re-filing with corresponding urgency given the time elapsed since the original filing on 2026-03-08.
notes:

For the remainder, the City states 'a good faith and diligent search yielded no records responsive to your request' while simultaneously releasing records on a rolling basis and promising a further response no later than 2026-06-11 — the same 'no responsive records' + rolling-production framing tracked in the disclosure-failure pattern. Not closed; still in rolling production.

For the first time since filing, a record was released — `_San_Mateo_Police_Department_-_FLOCK.pdf` (24 pp.). The City states it "was located within an email mailbox during the Department's good-faith search" and "may also have been responsive to prior requests," but was "not identified during the searches conducted at that time and [was] only recently located in connection with the Department's search for records responsive to this request."

The file is the 2020 Flock contract set: the Phase 1 Services Agreement Order Form (12 cameras, $24,000/yr, 24-month initial term; signed by Lt. Todd Mefford 2020-08-17); a Phase 2 Additional Services Agreement Order Form (9 Flock Falcon cameras, $22,500/yr, 24-month initial term; dated 2020-11-19, signed by Lt. Mefford 2020-11-23); the 2020 Government Agency Customer Agreement, whose §4.1 carries the earlier form of the Footage-disclosure language now at MSA §5.3; PandaDoc signature certificates for both order forms; and a City of San Mateo Purchase Contract with Flock Group dated 2020-08-17, signed by Chief Ed Barberini.

No §5.3 notification, tracking record, SMPD–Flock communication, or disclosure log/accounting (Items 1–3 and 5) has been produced. Next update promised no later than 2026-11-11.
